newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei average closes up one percent.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei average closes up one percent.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key benchmark ended more than one percent higher on Wednesday after both domestic and institutional investors moved to buy blue-chip issues, extending early morning gains inspired by a record high close on Wall Street overnight, brokers said.
The Nikkei 225 closed 233.78 points or 1.12 percent higher at 21,189.96. Its December futures rose 230 points at 21,220.
"Blue chips led the way today," said Yasuo Ueki, general manager at Nikko Securities. "However, selling pressure was fairly strong around the 21,300 level and the index could not make much headway."
